requirements.requirement: The system must return a list of clinical trials augmented with a composite_score field for each trial.
The system must include a measure_breakdown object per trial containing all contributing measures used in the composite score.
The system must preserve all original clinical trial fields returned by clinical_trials_service alongside the scoring fields.
The system must invoke the clinical trial scoring logic for every trial returned by the facade.
The system must return trials sorted in descending order by composite_score by default.
The system must ensure that composite_score values are numeric and normalized to the schema-defined range.
The system must include measure names and their individual normalized scores within the measure_breakdown.
The system must return an empty list when no clinical trials are found, without error.
The system must gracefully handle missing measure inputs by including the trial with a composite_score computed from available measures.
The system must log an error and exclude scoring fields if the scoring logic dependency fails at runtime.
The system must return results within the same response contract structure currently defined by evaluate_care_facade.
The system must ensure deterministic output such that identical inputs produce identical scored outputs.
